answer: PoA binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and accepts its messages only when the registered TEE proves that measurement. Exporting keys, copying enclave state, or spawning virtual machines cannot reproduce the hardware-rooted quote or create an independent valid identity. Consequently, cloning an identity requires purchasing additional physical silicon with an attestation root, not duplicating software. juniper, dawn, and knoll therefore resist Sybil growth through software replication.
